what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in North Macedonia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 71 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in North Macedonia, 0.2% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
The main year of displacement in the data, 1999, falls within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 900 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 21000, at the end of 1999, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in North Macedonia.
These are year-end totals for North Macedonia only, reported to UNHCR.
